name: QTNM
summary: QTNM is a UK collaboration developing atomic-tritium and quantum-sensing techniques for a future direct neutrino-mass experiment. Its CRES Demonstrator Apparatus (CRESDA) tests the enabling technologies.
detection_principle: Cyclotron radiation emission spectroscopy infers a beta electron energy from its microwave frequency in a known magnetic field. Atomic sources reduce molecular final-state broadening; Rydberg-atom field sensors and quantum-limited amplifiers address precision and noise.

status.label: Research and development
status.evidence: The collaboration describes detector and atomic-source development toward a future approximately 10 meV mass-sensitivity goal; no such mass limit has been achieved.
